component.name: NAHPU
component.summary: A digital cataloging app for natural history specimens

description.p: NAHPU (NAtural History Project Utility), loosely named after the Greater Malay Chevrotain, Tragulus napu, is a field cataloging application for natural history collections.
NAHPU records specimens, collecting events, sites, narratives, and media in a single project database. It works fully offline in the field and keeps every project in a self-contained file you own.

ul.li: Catalog mammalogy, ornithology, herpetology, and invertebrate zoology specimens with discipline-specific forms
Record collecting events, sites, and coordinates on an offline map
Attach photographs, audio recordings, and field narratives
Export to Darwin Core and CSV for museum and aggregator ingest
Print specimen labels and catalog sheets
Share projects across desktop and mobile devices

description.p: Renames the arthropod catalog to invertebrates and names catalog formats for their discipline, with automatic migration of existing custom-field definitions. Replaces the database backup management UI with a concise summary and action list, improves documentation and record statistics, and fixes missing personnel photos when restoring old database backups.
